format: PNG, 8-bit RGBA, straight alpha, no metadata
slice_px: insets in the PNG's own pixels (2x); halve for laid-out units

text_styles._note: For launcher.json's text styles: face, weight and colour; keep your sizes. 'heading' can instead be the page-name pictures in exports/launcher/page-names/.

value._why: paths and ids must be plainly readable

buttonSmall._frame: button_quiet_* (the nine-slice takes the smaller height)

mapping.panel framed: panel + corner_plate x4; the page's heading in a velvet title band, the rule under it as frieze
mapping.notice: colours.scrim over the screen, then the same framed panel
mapping.nav mark (8 wide): colours.mark_selected when chosen, nothing otherwise (nav_selected already carries a bar)

panel.note: Frame and field. Draw bands, friezes and content inside content_inset, then corner_plate on all four corners last.

corner_plate.note: Free-standing quatrefoil knot, its diamond filled dark so lines beneath end at its edge. Place the image's top-left on each corner of a panel (no mirroring needed); draw after everything else.

frieze.note: The rolled-seal band between registers; repeat across.

velvet.note: Velvet ground; tile it, then stretch velvet_shade over the same rectangle.

velvet_shade.note: Light from above on velvet; stretch to the band.

sep_chevron.note: Stretch the two arms; the centre stays.

checkbox_off.note: Drawn on the 16-unit reference and laid out at 32 (64 px at 2x), as the launcher draws it; the label beside it on the same baseline. Focused replaces the plain state; pressed shows while the button is held.

nav_focused.note: Drawn over a menu item (selected or not) when it has the keyboard focus.

row_chosen.note: The chosen row of a list (the copy of the game in use): its edge and a light wash.

row_focused.note: Drawn over a list row (chosen or not) when the keyboard is on it, e.g. a radio list whose whole row is the radio.
